fields.name: ACME_DNS_STORAGE_BASE_URL
fields.label: The ACME-DNS JSON account data server.

fields.name: ACME_DNS_STORAGE_PATH
fields.label: The ACME-DNS JSON account data file. A per-domain account will be registered/persisted to this file and used for TXT updates.

fields.name: AURORA_API_KEY
fields.label: API key or username to used

fields.name: BINDMAN_MANAGER_ADDRESS
fields.label: The server URL, should have scheme, hostname, and port (if required) of the Bindman-DNS Manager server

fields.name: BLUECAT_SERVER_URL
fields.label: The server URL, should have scheme, hostname, and port (if required) of the authoritative Bluecat BAM serve

fields.name: BLUECATV2_SERVER_URL
fields.label: The server URL: it should have a scheme, hostname, and port (if required) of the authoritative Bluecat BAM serve

fields.name: CF_DNS_API_TOKEN
fields.label: API token with DNS:Edit permission (since v3.1.0)

fields.name: CF_ZONE_API_TOKEN
fields.label: API token with Zone:Read permission (since v3.1.0)

fields.name: CLOUDNS_AUTH_PASSWORD
fields.label: The password for API user ID

fields.name: CORENETWORKS_LOGIN
fields.label: The username of the API account

fields.name: DNSHOMEDE_CREDENTIALS
fields.label: Comma-separated list of domain:password credential pairs

fields.name: DNSMINT_API_KEY
fields.label: API key with the dns01:write scope

fields.name: DNSUPDATE_NAMESERVER
fields.label: Network address in the form "host" or "host:port"

fields.name: AKAMAI_ACCESS_TOKEN
fields.label: Access token, managed by the Akamai EdgeGrid client

fields.name: AKAMAI_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Client secret, managed by the Akamai EdgeGrid client

fields.name: AKAMAI_CLIENT_TOKEN
fields.label: Client token, managed by the Akamai EdgeGrid client

fields.name: AKAMAI_EDGERC
fields.label: Path to the .edgerc file, managed by the Akamai EdgeGrid client

fields.name: AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION
fields.label: Configuration section, managed by the Akamai EdgeGrid client

fields.name: AKAMAI_HOST
fields.label: API host, managed by the Akamai EdgeGrid client

fields.name: EUSERV_EMAIL
fields.label: The customer email address. You can also use the customer id instead.

fields.name: EUSERV_ORDER_ID
fields.label: The order ID of the API contract that you want to use for this login session.

fields.name: GCE_PROJECT
fields.label: Project name (by default, the project name is auto-detected by using the metadata service)

fields.name: GIGAHOSTNO_API_KEY
fields.label: API key (optionnal of GIGAHOSTNO_USERNAME and GIGAHOSTNO_PASSWORD are defined)

fields.name: HOSTUP_API_KEY
fields.label: API token (required scopes: read:dns, write:dns, read:domains)

fields.name: IIJ_DPF_DPM_SERVICE_CODE
fields.label: IIJ Managed DNS Service's service code

fields.name: JOKER_API_MODE
fields.label: 'DMAPI' or 'SVC'. DMAPI is for resellers accounts. (Default: DMAPI)

fields.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client. Access key ID (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

fields.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client. Secret access key (`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

fields.name: DNS_ZONE
fields.label: Domain name of the DNS zone

fields.name: METANAME_ACCOUNT_REFERENCE
fields.label: The four-digit reference of a Metaname account

fields.name: MYADDR_PRIVATE_KEYS_MAPPING
fields.label: Mapping between subdomains and private keys. The format is: `<subdomain1>:<private_key1>,<subdomain2>:<private_key2>,<subdomain3>:<private_key3>`

fields.name: NAMESURFER_BASE_URL
fields.label: The base URL of NameSurfer API (jsonrpc10) endpoint URL (e.g., https://foo.example.com:8443/API/NSService_10)

fields.name: NICRU_PASSWORD
fields.label: Password for an account in RU CENTER

fields.name: NICRU_SECRET
fields.label: Secret for application in DNS-hosting RU CENTER

fields.name: NICRU_SERVICE_ID
fields.label: Service ID for application in DNS-hosting RU CENTER

fields.name: NICRU_USER
fields.label: Agreement for an account in RU CENTER

fields.name: OCI_FINGERPRINT
fields.label: Public key fingerprint (ignored if `OCI_AUTH_TYPE` is not empty)

fields.name: OCI_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD
fields.label: Private key password (ignored if `OCI_AUTH_TYPE` is not empty)

fields.name: OCI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
fields.label: Private key file (ignored if `OCI_AUTH_TYPE` is not empty)

fields.name: OCI_REGION
fields.label: Region (it can be empty if `OCI_AUTH_TYPE` is not empty).

fields.name: OCI_TENANCY_OCID
fields.label: Tenancy OCID (ignored if `OCI_AUTH_TYPE` is not empty)

fields.name: OCI_USER_OCID
fields.label: User OCID (ignored if `OCI_AUTH_TYPE` is not empty)

fields.name: PLESK_SERVER_BASE_URL
fields.label: Base URL of the server (ex: https://plesk.myserver.com:8443)

fields.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client. Access key ID (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

fields.name: AWS_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN
fields.label: Managed by the AWS Role ARN (`AWS_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN_FILE` is not supported)

fields.name: AWS_EXTERNAL_ID
fields.label: Managed by STS AssumeRole API operation (`AWS_EXTERNAL_ID_FILE` is not supported)

fields.name: AWS_PROFILE
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client (`AWS_PROFILE_FILE` is not supported)

fields.name: AWS_REGION
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client (`AWS_REGION_FILE` is not supported)

fields.name: AWS_SDK_LOAD_CONFIG
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client. Retrieve the region from the CLI config file (`AWS_SDK_LOAD_CONFIG_FILE` is not supported)

fields.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
fields.label: Managed by the AWS client. Secret access key (`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

fields.name: AWS_WAIT_FOR_RECORD_SETS_CHANGED
fields.label: Wait for changes to be INSYNC (it can be unstable)

fields.name: VK_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID
fields.label: String ID of project in VK Cloud

fields.name: WEDOS_USERNAME
fields.label: Username is the same as for the admin account

fields.name: WEDOS_WAPI_PASSWORD
fields.label: Password needs to be generated and IP allowed in the admin interface

fields.name: YANDEX_CLOUD_FOLDER_ID
fields.label: The string id of folder (aka project) in Yandex Cloud

fields.name: YANDEX_CLOUD_IAM_TOKEN
fields.label: The base64 encoded json which contains information about iam token of service account with `dns.admin` permissions
